name: funkwiz

scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run deploy:worker
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:e2e: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config e2e/worker/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state
scripts.db:migrate:e2e-google: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config e2e/worker/google.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-google-state
scripts.db:migrate:e2e-school: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config e2e/worker/school.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-school-state

description: Playful, self-hosted classroom quizzes on Cloudflare Workers.

DB.description: Stores your teacher account, quizzes and reports. A fresh database is created for this installation.

LIVE_ROOMS.description: Coordinates live quizzes and authoritative timers.

LIVE_JOIN_LIMITER.description: Limits attempts to guess student game codes.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Your final HTTPS app origin, e.g. https://funkwiz.YOUR-SUBDOMAIN.workers.dev (no trailing path). Update this when changing domains.

TEACHER_EMAIL.description: The bootstrap teacher email for this installation. Personal mode uses this one teacher; opt-in School mode adds invited teachers.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Generate a unique random secret of at least 32 characters, e.g. with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Do not reuse a sample value.

TEACHER_SETUP_TOKEN.description: Generate a second unique secret with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Keep it in your password manager: it is required to create the teacher account and recover its password.

FUNKWIZ_MODE.description: Installation mode: personal for one teacher, or school for invited teachers and workspaces. The Personal and School deploy buttons preselect this non-secret value.
